workflow_metadata.name: Approach Detection Workflow
workflow_metadata.description: Automatically detect bottom-up, top-down, reverse engineering (overhaul), or language migration approach
workflow_metadata.purpose: Route to 01b-bottom_up_integration, 01c-top_down_design, 01e-reverse_engineering, or 01f-language_migration based on system analysis
workflow_metadata.context_reduction: Reduced from 1,535 lines to ~200 lines (87% reduction)
workflow_metadata.v4.1.0_changes: Added overhaul detection for legacy system takeover and language migration scenarios

workflow_steps.name: Auto-Detect Integration Approach
workflow_steps.description: Automatically detect approach by examining system directory and user intent: bottom-up (Reflow-compatible existing components), top-down (greenfield), reverse_engineering (unknown/legacy takeover), or language_migration (modernization)
workflow_steps.when_to_use: When using 'auto' entry point - LLM examines system directory and user context to determine approach

actions.description: Examine system directory structure for existing components
Check for Reflow artifacts (working_memory.json, specs/machine/, specs/functional/)

overhaul_indicators.no_reflow_artifacts: System has code but no Reflow specs

actions.description: Classify system approach based on evidence

classification_rules.top_down: No existing code in system_root, greenfield project
classification_rules.bottom_up: Existing code WITH Reflow artifacts (or Reflow-compatible structure)
classification_rules.reverse_engineering: Existing code WITHOUT Reflow artifacts, unknown system takeover
classification_rules.language_migration: User explicitly requests language conversion OR legacy language detected

actions.description: Route to appropriate workflow based on detected approach

quality_gates.enforcement: Approach detection is informational only, no blocking gates

next_workflow.routing_note: LLM reads context/approach_detection_result.json to determine next workflow

when_to_suggest_reverse_engineering: User says 'need to understand what this system does'
Existing code found but NO Reflow artifacts (no working_memory.json, no specs/)
User asks to 'take over' or 'pick up' an existing system
when_to_suggest_language_migration: User explicitly mentions 'migrate from X to Y'
Legacy languages detected (COBOL, Fortran, Python 2, Perl, Visual Basic)
User asks to 'rewrite in' a different language
User mentions specific source and target languages
overhaul_detection.disambiguation_prompt:
I detected existing code. Would you like to:
1. **Reverse Engineer** - Extract architecture from this unknown codebase
2. **Migrate Language** - Convert this code to a different language
3. **Bottom-Up Integration** - Integrate these existing components (assumes Reflow-compatible)
4. **Top-Down Design** - Start fresh, ignore existing code

version_history.changes: Added reverse_engineering and language_migration approach detection for System Overhaul feature
